name: Advertisement content
description: Advertisement source allowing to create advertisements via the administrative UI.
project_description: Advertisement content is the native content-provider (bucket) submodule of the Advertisement (ad) project. It defines the revisionable, translatable ad_content entity and its bundles (Image advertisement, Text advertisement), the AdContentBucket plugin that supplies random published ads to advertisement blocks, image field formatters (with and without click tracking), and an AJAX controller that renders ads into placeholders so impressions can be tracked per view.
